prompt.flux: Semi-realistic anime-style background art for a visual novel, wide shot, no people. A small, cramped room in an old tenement of a dense, neon-lit night city, the kind of building with an air-conditioning unit bolted under every window. A warm desk lamp lights a table covered with handwritten notes, a notebook and printed papers; unopened cardboard moving boxes stand along the wall. The window is the focal point: across a narrow alley stands an old red brick apartment building with iron fire escapes, and one of its windows glows warm amber. Magenta and pink neon light from the street below spills across the ceiling. Cold blue-violet shadows against the warm lamp; quiet, lonely, slightly uneasy; subtle film grain.
